compare-specific-page-range-pdf.title: Compare Selected Page Range of Two PDFs
compare-specific-page-range-pdf.description: Loads two PDF documents, extracts text from a specified page range using Aspose.Pdf, and compares the extracted content to determine if the pages are identical.

compare-pdf-documents-page-by-page-diff.title: Compare PDF Page Dimensions and Generate Summary Report
compare-pdf-documents-page-by-page-diff.description: Loads two PDF files, compares their page counts and page dimensions, and creates a diff PDF containing a summary of any differences.

compare-selected-pdf-pages-side-by-side.title: Compare Specific PDF Pages Using Side‑by‑Side Comparison
compare-selected-pdf-pages-side-by-side.description: Demonstrates how to compare selected pages of two PDFs by passing a page list to Aspose.Pdf's side‑by‑side comparer and saving each diff result as a separate PDF.

exclude-areas-from-pdf-comparison.title: Compare PDFs with Excluded Areas Using Side‑by‑Side Comparison
exclude-areas-from-pdf-comparison.description: Shows how to compare two PDF documents side‑by‑side while excluding specific rectangular regions from each file using Aspose.Pdf comparison options.

exclude-annotations-from-pdf-comparison.title: Exclude Annotations from PDF Comparison
exclude-annotations-from-pdf-comparison.description: Demonstrates how to collect annotation bounding rectangles from two PDFs and exclude those areas from a side‑by‑side visual comparison using Aspose.Pdf.

exclude-footer-areas-in-pdf-comparison.title: Exclude Footer Areas from PDF Comparison
exclude-footer-areas-in-pdf-comparison.description: Demonstrates how to perform a side‑by‑side PDF comparison while excluding the footer region by adding rectangular excluded areas to the comparison options.

compare-two-pdfs-aspdf-comparison.title: Side‑by‑Side PDF Comparison with Aspose.Pdf
compare-two-pdfs-aspdf-comparison.description: Loads two PDF documents, configures comparison options, and generates a side‑by‑side visual comparison PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

set-custom-image-similarity-tolerance-pd.title: Set Custom Image Similarity Tolerance for PDF Comparison
set-custom-image-similarity-tolerance-pd.description: Shows how to configure a GraphicalPdfComparer with a custom threshold to compare scanned PDFs and generate a diff PDF.

compare-pdfs-with-form-fields.title: Compare PDFs Including Form Field Values
compare-pdfs-with-form-fields.description: Shows how to perform a side‑by‑side visual comparison of two PDF documents with Aspose.Pdf, ensuring that form field values are taken into account in the diff.

compare-pdfs-different-page-sizes.title: Compare PDFs with Different Page Sizes and Text Content
compare-pdfs-different-page-sizes.description: Loads two PDF files, checks for page count and size differences, extracts pure text from each page, and reports whether dimensions and text match.

compare-pdf-text-ignoring-compression.title: Compare PDF Text While Ignoring Compression Differences
compare-pdf-text-ignoring-compression.description: Loads two PDFs with different compression settings, extracts their pure text using Aspose.Pdf, and compares the extracted strings to verify that compression does not affect textual differences.

compare-pdfs-unicode-text-differences.title: Compare PDFs with Unicode Text Extraction
compare-pdfs-unicode-text-differences.description: Loads two PDF files, extracts their Unicode text using Aspose.Pdf's TextAbsorber, and reports line‑by‑line differences to verify multilingual content handling.

compare-pdfs-detect-font-differences.title: Compare PDFs and Detect Font Differences
compare-pdfs-detect-font-differences.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf to compare two PDF files, count font‑related diff operations, and optionally create a side‑by‑side visual diff PDF.

compare-encrypted-pdfs-side-by-side.title: Compare Encrypted PDFs with Passwords
compare-encrypted-pdfs-side-by-side.description: Demonstrates loading password‑protected PDF files and performing a visual side‑by‑side comparison using Aspose.Pdf's comparison API.

in-memory-pdf-comparison-diff.title: Merge Two PDFs into a Comparison Document
in-memory-pdf-comparison-diff.description: Shows how to load two PDFs from in‑memory byte arrays, add a title and separator page, merge their pages into a single PDF, and return the result as a byte array without creating temporary files.

generate-visual-diff-pdf.title: Create Visual PDF Diff with GraphicalPdfComparer
generate-visual-diff-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to generate a visual difference PDF by loading two documents and using Aspose.Pdf's GraphicalPdfComparer to produce a side‑by‑side diff output.

get-image-differences-between-pdf-pages.title: Detect Visual Differences Between Two PDFs
get-image-differences-between-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to compare two PDF files page‑by‑page using Aspose.Pdf's GraphicalPdfComparer to find pixel‑level visual differences and optionally export diff images.

generate-diff-pdf-by-comparing-two-pdfs.title: Generate Diff PDF with Side‑by‑Side Comparison
generate-diff-pdf-by-comparing-two-pdfs.description: Loads two PDF files, compares them side‑by‑side using Aspose.Pdf.Comparison, and saves a diff PDF that highlights the changes to a specified output folder.

generate-diff-pdf-highlighted-text-chang.title: Generate Diff PDF and Verify Highlight Colors
generate-diff-pdf-highlighted-text-chang.description: Creates a diff PDF that highlights text changes using Aspose.Pdf's comparison feature, then checks that all highlight annotations use the default yellow color.

compare-pdfs-generate-json-diff-report.title: Generate JSON Diff Report from PDF Comparison
compare-pdfs-generate-json-diff-report.description: Demonstrates how to compare two PDFs with Aspose.Pdf, create a visual side‑by‑side result, extract text diff operations per page, and serialize them into a JSON report.

replace-text-using-diffoperation.title: Replace PDF Text with Content from Another PDF
replace-text-using-diffoperation.description: Loads two PDF files, extracts the text from each page of the first PDF, clears the corresponding page in the second PDF, and inserts the extracted text, then saves the result.

compare-pdfs-log-differences.title: Compare Two PDFs and Log Text Differences by Page
compare-pdfs-log-differences.description: Shows how to compare two PDF files page‑by‑page using Aspose.Pdf, extract each page's text with TextAbsorber, and write page count or text mismatches to a log file for auditing.

compare-two-pdfs-visual-diff.title: Side-by-side PDF Comparison with Aspose.Pdf
compare-two-pdfs-visual-diff.description: Loads two PDF files, configures side‑by‑side comparison options, and uses Aspose.Pdf's SideBySidePdfComparer to generate a PDF that highlights differences, including embedded multimedia.

preserve-original-metadata-in-diff-pdf.title: Compare PDFs and Preserve Metadata in Diff Document
preserve-original-metadata-in-diff-pdf.description: Loads two PDF files, copies the original PDF's metadata to a new diff PDF, compares page counts and page‑by‑page text, and creates a diff PDF that highlights any differences.

multi-threaded-pdf-comparison.title: Parallel PDF Comparison Using Aspose.Pdf
multi-threaded-pdf-comparison.description: Demonstrates how to compare multiple PDF files concurrently by checking page counts and full text content with Aspose.Pdf, collecting results in a thread‑safe collection.

batch-pdf-comparison-parallel.title: Batch PDF Comparison with Parallel Processing
batch-pdf-comparison-parallel.description: Demonstrates how to compare a large set of PDF files against a reference PDF using parallel processing with a bounded degree of concurrency, extracting and comparing text content.

generate-pdf-diff-images-zip.title: Export PDF Comparison Diff Images to ZIP Archive
generate-pdf-diff-images-zip.description: Shows how to compare two PDFs with Aspose.Pdf, generate a side‑by‑side comparison PDF, render each diff page to PNG, and bundle the images into a ZIP file.

compare-pdfs-ignore-signature-fields.title: Compare PDFs While Ignoring Digital Signature Fields
compare-pdfs-ignore-signature-fields.description: Demonstrates how to compare two PDF documents using Aspose.Pdf while treating digital signature fields as unchanged regions, by excluding them from text and form‑field comparisons.

write-pdf-comparison-diff-to-http-respon.title: Write PDF Comparison Diff Directly to HTTP Response
write-pdf-comparison-diff-to-http-respon.description: Demonstrates how to compare two PDFs and stream the side‑by‑side diff PDF straight to an HTTP response using Aspose.Pdf's comparison API.
